migrate.title: Move a project to another server
migrate.body: Pick both ends. Preflight decides whether the bytes go straight from the source or relay through this computer, and nothing is copied until every check passes.
migrate.needTwoServers: A migration needs two saved servers. Add the destination in Settings → Connections.
migrate.excludesHint: These are the build outputs that make a project bigger than the source disk. One path component each; the exact rsync command below shows them.
migrate.commands: Exact commands, in order, before anything runs
migrate.cancelled: Cancelled. The staging directory is kept, so running it again resumes — the destination was not touched.
migrate.verification: After: {{files}} files, {{dirs}} directories, {{bytes}} bytes — sample checksum compared.
